reason: This changes core system-variable scope in `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go` and threads it into `pkg/expression/exprstatic/evalctx.go`, so it is not just an observability tweak. Moving `tidb_redact_log` from session to global changes user-visible session behavior and redaction/visibility semantics across executor, planner, slow-query, and table-related paths; if wrong, it can cause cross-session regressions or sensitive SQL leakage. That is central and risky enough to justify a focused Blocker/High review.
